description: Two switches driven by one control voltage: one input sent to either of two outputs, and either of two inputs sent to one output

inputs.text: Sets the position of both switch sections; it counts as high above 3.6V and falls back low below 3.2V, and with nothing patched it reads 0V
The signal fed into the one-into-two section, sent to one of that section's two outputs while the other is held at 0V
Passed to the two-into-one section's output while the CV input is below 3.2V
Passed to the two-into-one section's output while the CV input is above 3.6V

outputs.text: Carries the one-into-two section's input while the CV input is above 3.2V, and 0V while CV is below it
Carries the one-into-two section's input while the CV input is above 3.6V, and 0V while CV is below it
Carries whichever of the two-into-one section's two inputs the CV input has picked

notes: polyphonic signals pass through, with every channel switched together by the one control voltage

inputs.0: high above 3.6V · stepped · one channel only
